Banks also carry a lot of debt by design — they borrow money to lend it out — so high leverage is normal and not a red flag.

company_profile.description_summary: Capitol Federal Financial, Inc. operates as the holding company for Capitol Federal Savings Bank that provides various retail banking products and services in the United States.
